eb9b167b31b8d15a47cb.en: The Coast Guard Fleet Division said today (7) that in order to verify the navigational performance of the coast guard vessels, strengthen cross-ship collaboration and maritime service capabilities, and deepen international maritime exchanges, the Fleet has jointly deployed 4,000-ton "Chiayi Ship" and 1,000-ton "Penghu Ship" to carry out the 115-year "Voyage Training and Maritime Diplomacy Project". The two ships set sail to Palau, a friendly country, last week to carry out voyage training and international exchange missions, and docked smoothly at the port of Malacca last (6) day. The Fleet Branch pointed out that in 114 years, the "Hualien Ship" and "Taipei Ship" were dispatched for the first time to complete the first long-distance training and practice Tunmu mission, accumulating experience in both fleet formations, ocean service and international cooperation. In this (115) year, the "Chiayi Ship" and the "Penghu Ship", which was delivered to the ship on July 21, formed the Dunmu Detachment to take over the baton and continue the results of the sea cruise training, which also allowed the Taiwan-Pakistan Sea Patrol Exchange to continue to deepen.

fa7bddc0518fd2488487.en: The Penghu District Public Prosecutor's Office received a report that the Kaohsiung "○Hongsheng" (hereinafter referred to as the "Hong" ship) used the fishery power oil discount approved by the government, and there was a considerable profit margin. The fishery power oil was fraudulently obtained by forging the voyage recorder (VDR) tracks, which made huge profits. The offence was very vicious and the circumstances were serious. The case was jointly investigated by the Penghu District Public Prosecutor's Office Zhongshu Lin Jiyin, who commanded the Penghu Detection and Defense Branch of the Coast Guard Branch and the Seventh Shore Patrol of the Golden Horse Pen Branch. After several months of investigation, it was determined that the captain of the "Hong" ship purchased a total of 62 fishery power oil discounts from CNPC Penghu Ma Gong Fishing Boat Filling Station from October 10, 112 to February 1, 115 with false operating hours. After investigation, the cumulative oil volume of abnormal track hours was 1,573,425 liters, and the overflow subsidy amounted to NT $4,382,295, which implicated Article 339 of the Criminal Law.
